selection.name: Call of the Wild
selection.description: The caster calls forth a Boar and a Hawk to aid in the battlefield.
selection.differences: Both Boar and Hawk are one spell.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Summons both Necro 3 units, Hawks gain Dive Bomb. When casted, all your summons gains 250 health.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Summons random dominated ancient creep, +2 Hawks spawned.

selection.name: Chaotic Offering
selection.description: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 1 second. The Golem lives for 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Calls 2 Golems with reduced stats.

selection.name: Chemical Rage
selection.description:
Enter into a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
selection.differences: Grants faster BAT for melee heroes.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: -0.1 base attack time. +50 health regeneration, +150 movement speed.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Chemical Rage now also casts on the closest unit to you.

selection.name: Cold Embrace
selection.description: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Now roots and disarms targets instead of stunning them.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Increases base heal by 25, and releases a max level Splinter Blast projectile on all enemies in 1200 radius around the target, dealing 340 damage and stunning them for 2 seconds.

selection.name: Corrosive Skin
selection.description: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1400 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Doubles attack speed slow and bonus magic resistance.
